project: Wuxia Life P8 Playability Gate and Human Test Slice
description: Establish a repeatable P8 playability gate for the 0-40 age slice, upgrade simulation from fixed fallback behavior to persona-driven strategy, produce evidence-rich automated reports, and prepare a 20-30 minute human-testable slice without expanding into talents, inventory, world map, or other endgame systems.

userStories.title: Baseline Current Simulation and Gate Coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only baseline of current simulation, gate, and browser coverage so that P8 starts from measured reality.
acceptanceCriteria: Document current commands for gameplay simulation, experience health, golden-line, headless parity, and browser runtime checks
Document which current outputs already reflect playability and which do not
Document current blind spots for active action choice, player agency, UI comprehension, and replay motivation
Save the baseline under docs/test-reports/
Do not modify business code

userStories.title: Define P8 Metric Schema
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want explicit playability metric keys so that P8 evaluates player value instead of feature count.
acceptanceCriteria: Define metric keys for agency, causality, achievement, frustration, replayability, pacing, and narrative memory
Each metric definition includes intent and scoring surface
Each metric declares whether it is measured by simulation, browser check, or human testing only
Save the metric schema in a P8 design note

userStories.title: Define Metric Thresholds and Severities
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want default thresholds and severities for each P8 metric so that the gate can make stable pass or fail decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Each P8 metric declares blocker, warning, or info severity behavior
Each simulation metric has a default threshold for the small-sample P8 gate
Human-only metrics are explicitly marked as non-blocking for automation
Save thresholds beside the metric definition

userStories.title: Define Persona Data Model
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a stable persona model so that simulation inputs remain deterministic and reviewable.
acceptanceCriteria: Define persona fields for stable id, name, gender, seed, strategy, and route preference
Define persona fields for risk preference and relationship preference
Define persona fields for 0-20, 20-30, and 30-40 short-term goals
Save the persona model in a P8 design note

userStories.title: Define Fixed Persona Roster
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a fixed set of simulated player personas so that automated runs cover distinct motivations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define 6-10 personas with stable ids, names, and seeds
Roster includes martial, scholarly, social, wealth-seeking, risk-averse, and deviant route tendencies
Each persona declares a primary strategy summary
Save the roster under docs/designs/

userStories.title: Define Persona Goal Profiles
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want each persona to have concrete short-term goals so that achievement can be measured against explicit intent.
acceptanceCriteria: Each persona defines 2-4 expected short goals
Each goal names the age band it belongs to
Each goal declares the evidence types that can satisfy it
Save the goal profile rules with the persona roster

userStories.title: Audit Action Fallback and Choice Scoring Entry Points
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to map the runtime entry points for no-event fallback and choice scoring so that P8 strategy changes land in the correct places.
acceptanceCriteria: Document where no-event active action fallback is selected today
Document where event choice scoring is applied today
Document current replay and sample commands that depend on these paths
Produce a short audit note without modifying business code

userStories.title: Define Persona-Driven Action Strategy Interface
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a focused strategy interface for no-event active action selection so that persona behavior can evolve without broad simulator rewrites.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the strategy input contract for persona, current state, and available action candidates
Define the strategy output contract for selected action and selection reason
Define minimum supported action directions: training, study, socializing, wealth or business, and exploration where available
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Strategy-Based No-Event Action Selection
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want simulated players to select active actions by persona strategy so that P8 no longer overfits to fixed training fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace or extend the fixed no-event action_training_basic fallback with persona-driven selection
Selection considers available action categories supported by the current runtime
Selected action records why it was chosen
Existing replay records remain replayable
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Test Persona Action Selection Behavior
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want deterministic tests for strategy-based active action selection so that no-event behavior does not silently regress.
acceptanceCriteria: Add deterministic tests for at least three different persona strategies
Tests verify selection reason is recorded
Tests verify unsupported categories degrade to available choices without crashing
Tests pass

userStories.title: Map Existing Choice Tendency to P8 Persona Bias
userStories.description: As a designer, I want current choice scoring to express persona intent so that simulations represent different player motivations without deleting route-track behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend or map existing choiceTendency scoring to P8 persona dimensions
Preserve current route-track behavior
Choice scoring considers goal alignment, risk preference, relationship preference, and route preference where applicable
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Record Choice Diagnostics for P8
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want choice scoring diagnostics captured in the simulator so that persona intent can be reviewed in reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulator records the selected choice score
Simulator records the top competing choice score
Diagnostics are attached to the simulation output in a machine-readable form
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Verify Persona Bias with Gameplay Samples
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the existing gameplay sample runner to keep working after persona bias changes so that P8 builds on stable simulation tooling.
acceptanceCriteria: simulate:gameplay:samples still runs successfully
At least two personas produce visibly different choice patterns in the sample output
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Agency Metric Data Collection
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want the simulator to measure player agency so that random playback regressions are caught automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Collect active action count, story event count, choice event count, and forced event count per persona
Collect active action diversity by category
Detect repeated no-event turns on the same action without route, goal, or narrative change
Write agency metric output to machine-readable JSON
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Causality Echo Metric
userStories.description: As a player, I want earlier choices to visibly affect later outcomes so that the reported life feels authored rather than random.
acceptanceCriteria: Count later requirements, unlocked choices, feedback text, route state changes, or report fields that reference earlier actions or choices
Distinguish direct causality from generic stat growth
Flag personas with too few causality echoes by age 40
Record strongest causality examples in structured output
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Achievement Metric
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want the report to evaluate whether personas achieve concrete short-term goals so that early-life payoff can be judged.
acceptanceCriteria: Report marks each persona goal as achieved, missed, or unavailable
Goal evidence references concrete flags, route states, stats, relationships, or event ids
Gate warns if most personas reach age 40 with no achieved goal
Write achievement metric output to machine-readable JSON
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Frustration and Recovery Metric
userStories.description: As a player, I want setbacks to feel fair so that failure creates retry desire rather than distrust.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect negative outcomes and classify them as warned, explained, recoverable, or opaque
Report the ratio of opaque negative outcomes per persona
Record at least one concrete example for each opaque setback
Gate fails when opaque setbacks exceed the blocker threshold
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Replay Difference Metric
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want different personas and seeds to produce measurably different lives so that replay value can be evaluated before adding larger systems.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare personas by route tags, key choices, active action distribution, relationship state, major stats, and age-40 summary
Compute machine-readable similarity scores
Report similarity clusters
Gate warns when multiple personas produce nearly identical route and summary outputs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Pacing and Boredom Metric
userStories.description: As a player, I want frequent meaningful change so that the 0-40 slice does not feel empty.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect long windows with no new choice, no route change, no relationship change, no meaningful stat threshold, and no new summary line
Report the longest low-impact span per persona
Gate fails when a persona hits a blocker-level low-impact span
Preserve existing gate:experience repetition blockers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Narrative Memory Summary Metric
userStories.description: As a tester, I want each simulated life to produce a readable narrative summary so that automation output can be reviewed like a player story.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a three-part summary for each persona covering early life, turning point, and age-40 identity
Include at least three cited evidence points from events, actions, or route changes
Mark missing identity or missing turning point as a warning
Write summary data to JSON-ready structures
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Assemble Machine-Readable P8 Report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one machine-readable report schema for all P8 metrics so that the gate and follow-up tooling consume stable output.
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregate per-persona and overall P8 metric output into one JSON report
Report includes metric verdicts, thresholds, and evidence references
Report path is stable under docs/test-reports/ or public/reports/
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Assemble Human-Readable P8 Markdown Report
userStories.description: As a designer, I want the automated playability output rendered as a readable report so that I can review it without opening raw JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a Markdown report for each P8 run
Report explains planning, causality, frustration, route differentiation, and replay differences in readable language
Report includes concrete evidence snippets instead of only numeric scores
Report links or references the machine-readable JSON output
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add Gate Playability Command
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one repeatable command for P8 playability checks so that future sessions can run the same acceptance gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a package script such as gate:playability
The command runs the fixed P8 persona set and produces a pass or fail decision
The command exits non-zero on blocker failures
The command writes stable JSON and Markdown reports
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Document P8 Human Slice Admission Scope
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want a precise definition of the 0-40 human test slice so that implementation does not drift into the full game.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the intended 20-30 minute experience from age 0 to 40
List required early routes, active actions, feedback surfaces, and summary surfaces
List explicit content minimums and non-goals
Clarify that the slice does not cover full endgame, complete item economy, or complete world map

userStories.title: Audit Current Game Against the Human Slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a gap audit between the current game and the P8 human slice so that only necessary blockers are pulled into scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current 0-40 route availability, active action categories, attribute visibility, relationship feedback, and summary UI
Classify each gap as blocker, warning, or defer
Do not implement fixes in this story
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/

userStories.title: Implement Minimum Active Action Coverage for the Slice
userStories.description: As a player, I want multiple viable things to do when no event forces me so that planning feels active in the local Web slice.
acceptanceCriteria: The 0-40 slice exposes at least training, study, social, and wealth or exploration-oriented active action directions where design allows
Each direction has visible reward, cost, risk, and likely use case
No large new subsystem is introduced beyond the minimum slice need
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Verify Active Action Coverage in Browser
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want local browser verification of the expanded active action coverage so that the slice works in the actual Web flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Each minimum active action direction can be selected in the local Web flow
Reward, cost, risk, and likely use case are visible to the player
gate:playability passes or reports only known non-blocking warnings after the change
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement Minimum Route Differentiation for the Slice
userStories.description: As a player, I want early life choices to lead toward different identities so that replaying the 0-40 slice feels meaningful.
acceptanceCriteria: The 0-40 slice supports at least three distinct early identities or route tendencies
At least two personas reach meaningfully different route or identity states by age 40 in the P8 gate
No new large route system is introduced beyond the minimum slice need
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Verify Route Differentiation in Browser
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want browser confirmation that route identity is actually visible to players in the human test slice.
acceptanceCriteria: Route identity or tendency is visible in UI or life summary
The local Web flow can surface at least two visibly different identity outcomes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement Attribute Meaning and Visibility Slice Polish
userStories.description: As a player, I want key attributes to explain what they affect so that growth feels meaningful instead of opaque.
acceptanceCriteria: The attribute panel shows player-facing meaning for key visible attributes
Hidden or implicit attributes are not exposed as exact numbers unless current self-awareness rules allow it
At least three choices or active actions visibly reference relevant attribute meaning
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Verify Attribute Meaning in Browser
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want browser confirmation that attribute meaning is understandable in the local slice.
acceptanceCriteria: Key visible attributes show player-facing meaning in the local Web flow
At least three visible references connect attributes to choices or active actions
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement Age-40 Life Summary for Human Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want the game to summarize the life so far so that I can judge whether the slice created a memorable story.
acceptanceCriteria: At or before age 40 the game can show a summary of goals, major choices, setbacks, route identity, and unexplored hints
Summary distinguishes player-driven active actions from forced story events
Summary includes at least one replay hook when available
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Verify Age-40 Summary in Browser
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want local browser verification of the age-40 summary flow so that human testers will see a coherent slice ending.
acceptanceCriteria: The local Web flow can reach the summary surface at or before age 40
Summary shows goals, route identity, setbacks, and replay hook when available
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Write Human Test Script and Observation Sheet
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want a repeatable test script and observation sheet so that human feedback can be compared across players.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a test script for 5-8 players and 20-30 minutes each
Include pre-test instructions that do not over-explain hidden systems
Include post-test questions about goal, causality, achievement, frustration, replay desire, and memorable story
Include an observer checklist for confusion, hesitation, boredom, and restart intent
Save the script under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/

userStories.title: Run Browser Acceptance for the Human Slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to verify the local Web flow before inviting human testers so that obvious runtime blockers are caught first.
acceptanceCriteria: Start a local Web session from the start screen
Play through enough turns to reach active action selection and at least one route or identity signal
Verify there are no blocking console errors during start, active action, choice, summary, and save or load if used
Capture notes for UX blockers that automation cannot judge
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Write P8 Closure Report
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want a final P8 closure report so that the next product decision is based on evidence instead of momentum.
acceptanceCriteria: Report automated gate result, major warnings, and blocker status
Report whether the human test slice meets the admission line
List remaining risks before human testing
Recommend one of run human testing, fix blockers first, or stop or reshape project direction
Include commands used for verification
